title: An Hour Up Here Costs Two WEEKS 🚡
description:
An hour on the top bench costs two weeks down here. From the deck of this chairlift you can see people on the ridge, still as posts.

I've never been up. Gran goes up every morning with a blanket big enough for two, and comes down for Sunday dinner to tell me I look older. Then one Sunday she didn't come down.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BENCH if you'd sit up there for someone you love.
